editions.rights: Constituted text of an ancient work; both e-texts carry a BORI copyright notice, and Smith's asks that copies not be passed on. We commit only the verses our claims cite (as quotation for citation, with this attribution) and a verse-count index; the full files are fetched into the gitignored .cache/ by pnpm canon:fetch. Shipping verse text in the app needs BORI's written permission (docs/research/sources.md). The 1958 Droṇaparvan may be in copyright in India until the end of 2028. Not legal advice.
